changelog: Wave 2 security hotfix (CVE-class) — server-only. Closes two pre-existing credential-leak paths to log infrastructure: (1) bootstrap.go:809 was emitting the first 8 characters of the live enrollment token to stdout/Loki on every config-patch — replaced with token_len=%d. (2) middleware/auth.go:70-71 was logging the full Request.URL.RawQuery for WebSocket paths, which captured ?token=<JWT> for clients on the deprecated query-param auth path — replaced with query_len=%d. No agent rebuild; agent-side updater setAuthHeaders defense-in-depth deferred to Wave 4 where it composes with the WS-message redesign and Phase 2 binary publish.
